title: Connect Dify
description: Enter your Dify host and a personal access token. They are stored only on this computer, in WorkBuddy.
description_en: Enter your Dify host and a personal access token. They are stored only on this computer, in WorkBuddy.

fields.label: Dify host
fields.description: The host name only, without https://, a port or a path. The server must be reachable over HTTPS on port 443. Your Dify admin must turn on the Open API.
fields.description_en: The host name only, without https://, a port or a path. The server must be reachable over HTTPS on port 443. Your Dify admin must turn on the Open API.

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.description: A personal access token is recommended. Its app access decides which apps the agent can find and run; it needs workspace access to manage plugins, model providers or tool credentials. A workspace access token can only find and run apps: it cannot manage plugins, model providers or tool credentials, or fill in the human-input form of a paused run.
